risk_flags.reason: Criterion 3 (enable hasNotesAccess for the cohort) was executed before its hard precondition was met. Criterion 1 requires flag-aware containment verified on EVERY named surface including the Progress page, but the containment audit covers only study queue, stats helpers, library, and navigation — the Progress page is entirely absent (audit line 26). Known prior context flags getProgressPageData activityDays/lifetimeStats as not flag-aware (aggregate leak). The flag was flipped live for external users while a documented containment gap on the Progress surface remains unverified, so notes-derived aggregate data can now reach external test users. Production impact / external exposure with incomplete containment.

The script performs a live write to Clerk user publicMetadata (auth-adjacent state on the sacred users domain) for three production accounts, and the executor reports having already run it. Scanner flagged this P1A on both auth_clerk_content and sacred_table_reference rules. An irreversible production auth/metadata change executed without human sign-off and before containment was verified.

The 'containment audit' is a hand-authored text file of PASS labels, not evidenced executable test output (no test command + machine output). Even taken at face value it omits the Progress page; its claims for surfaces [1]-[4] are unverifiable from this pack.
